description:
First step: show the first scheduled run, its period and delivery destinations without enabling it.
Ask the user for an explicit IANA timezone; never infer it from their device or account.
local_time uses HH:MM; weekly weekday uses 0=Monday through 6=Sunday.
destination_ids are digest destination IDs; omitting them selects the owner's personal chat.
Show the returned preview and obtain timezone and external-audience confirmation before saving.
After access expires, first explicitly reactivate collection with configure_digest activate and consent=true,
then preview and confirm the schedule again. Missed runs are not sent in a batch.
name: preview_digest_schedule
title: Preview Digest Schedule
